Asset type: standalone square transparent PNG header illustration for the Analysis page of a sophisticated biology wiki.
Scene/backdrop: genuine transparent alpha background, entirely isolated painted object, no canvas rectangle or backdrop.

Subject: a tactile forest-teal magnifying glass angled across an airy linked cluster of lavender-violet molecular beads; several beads visible through its lens, with small warm amber accents and cream highlights.
Style/medium: visibly hand-painted oil pastel and crayon with thick impasto pigment, rough dry-brush edges, layered scribbled wax strokes, rich physical painted texture; sophisticated cool science-tech editorial art.
Composition/framing: square composition, centered isolated illustration, complete clear silhouette, generous transparent margin; readable when displayed as a small page header.

Constraints: abstract decorative molecular motif, not a factual molecular diagram; no text, letters, numbers, logos, watermarks, charts, labels or experimental results. No flat vector styling, no smooth plastic 3D, no white or colored canvas rectangle. Preserve genuinely transparent background.
